exposure_rule: All previously exposed July 7-18 outcomes are training only. Freeze before reading July 21-25 outcomes. One fit, no tuning or selection on validation or test.
depth_definition: Best five occupied price levels per side, or all available if fewer. Log sums, imbalance, top quantity share and distance to deepest included level. Read current reconstructed book only at completed-event decision.
temporal_definition: Completed F_LAST quotes within inclusive trailing five seconds. Mid change from oldest retained quote, range and summed absolute successive mid changes within that window. Reset history and depletion credits with OFI startup or inactivity reset.
reload_definition: Within each continuous same-best-price episode, queue increases match earlier unmatched decreases FIFO, each decrease no older than five seconds. Sum matched increases completed in trailing five seconds and divide by current bid plus ask quantity. Best-price changes discard unmatched credit for that side. This is visible queue reload, not confirmed executions, native icebergs or hidden liquidity.
absorption_definition: Positive or negative known-side five-second net CVD magnitude divided by current total best depth and by one plus same-direction positive mid change. This is a flow-versus-price proxy, not proof of absorption.
sampling: First completed event at least one second after prior decision. One tick spread, five-second warmup since OFI reset, decision plus 17 seconds strictly before window end. No feature sign filter.
target_definition: Unchanged cost-baseline executable-quote long and short targets. Both cross spread and pay one extra tick. No-entry and unresolved targets stay unknown, not no-trade labels. Keep late exits and inactivity flags; fit all resolved targets.

model.splitting: Fixed train-only root quantiles k/16 for k=1..15, numpy linear method, reused at every node. Greedy reduction of summed squared long and short error. Child leaves must satisfy support. Ties retain first feature then threshold. Gain must exceed 1e-9. No bootstrap, pruning, weights, refitting or hyperparameter search. Leaf predicts its two train means.

policy: Same frozen cost policy: maximum predicted net strictly above 0.5 ticks, no trade on ties, one position and ten-second cooldown after exit or entry rejection or expiry. Select before reading future status. Report unavailable and unresolved selections.
positive_gate: At least 100 closed test trades and 20 each test day, positive mean net pooled and every test day, no unresolved or inactivity-exposed selected test trades. No automatic promotion even if passing.
quality_rule: Abort entire cohort on any source hash, metadata, mapping, book, clock, event-completeness or coverage failure. No successful subset, retries with relaxed rules or retrospective split changes.
